description: Synthetic gold-standard examples for per-field evaluation of the extraction layer. Inputs are CleanDocument-shaped blocks; expected values include explicit nulls where honest abstention is the correct answer. v0.2 adds 21 adversarial edge cases: zero/boundary numbers, separator traps, conflicting statements, table pathologies, campaign-type traps, currency/segment conflicts, content injection, and validity traps.
licence_boundary: All example texts are synthetic and written for this repository; they imitate live wording patterns but contain no bank-specific real numbers or third-party excerpts. Apache-2.0.
